# JSON Group (`json`)

Opt-in library group `json`. Disabled by default; enable it in the host environment to call `json.*` functions (see [`spec/packages/f06-groups.md`](../../spec/packages/f06-groups.md)).

| Entry | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`json.stringify`](#jsonstringify) | `json.stringify(x: any) => string` | The JSON form of a value, as text. |
| [`json.parse`](#jsonparse) | `json.parse(s: string) => any !` | The value that a JSON text describes. |

## `json.stringify`

The JSON form of a value, as text.

```text
json.stringify: (x: any) => string
```

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Parameters | `x: any` |
| Returns | `string` |
| Returns null | Never |
| Steps | `walk(x) + sz(result)` |
| Allocation units | `1 + sz(result)` |
| Type checker | Renders `x` as text |
| Since | `3.0` |

**Run-time failures**

| Code | Kind | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wrong-kind` (`json`) | `kind` | x is an opaque value or holds one at any depth |
| `depth-exceeded` | `limit` | the walk passes the depth limit |

**Examples**

| Expression | Inputs | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `json.stringify(null)` |  | `"null"` |
| `json.stringify("a\"b")` |  | `"\"a\\\"b\""` |
| `json.stringify([1, "a", null, true])` |  | `"[1,\"a\",null,true]"` |
| `json.stringify({b: 1, a: [true]})` |  | `"{\"a\":[true],\"b\":1}"` |
| `json.stringify(x)` | `x = [1e+21,1.5e-7,100,0.30000000000000004]` | `"[1e+21,1.5e-7,100,0.30000000000000004]"` |
| `json.stringify(s)` | `s = "\u0001\t\u007f\u2028/<&"` | `"\"\\u0001\\t\u007f\u2028/<&\""` |
| `json.stringify(t)` | `t = <opaque Token>` | Fails: `wrong-kind` — an opaque value cannot be written as JSON |
| `json.stringify(x)` | `x = [[[1]]]; limits: depth = 2` | Fails: `depth-exceeded` |

## `json.parse`

The value that a JSON text describes.

```text
json.parse: (s: string) => any !
```

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Parameters | `s: string` |
| Returns | `any` (may fail with a value error, `!`) |
| Returns null | When the JSON text is the value null |
| Steps | `8*sz(s) + c` |
| Allocation units | `u` |
| Since | `3.0` |

**Run-time failures**

| Code | Kind | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `invalid-argument` (`not-json`) | `value` | s is not a JSON text by the grammar of RFC 8259 |
| `invalid-argument` (`integer-range`) | `value` | a number with no fraction and no exponent is not a whole number |
| `number-range` (`entry`) | `range` | a number with a fraction or an exponent reads as an infinity |
| `depth-exceeded` | `limit` | the nesting of the text passes the depth limit |

**Examples**

| Expression | Inputs | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `json.parse("{\"b\": [1, 2.5, -0], \"a\": null}")` |  | `{"b":[1,2.5,0],"a":null}` |
| `json.parse(" 42\n")` |  | `42` |
| `json.parse("\"x\"")` |  | `"x"` |
| `json.parse("true")` |  | `true` |
| `json.parse(s)` | `s = "{\"a\":[1,2],\"b\":\"x\"}"` | `{"a":[1,2],"b":"x"}` (6 steps, 9 units) |
| `json.parse(s)` | `s = "{\"a\":[1],\"a\":2}"` | `{"a":2}` (5 steps, 5 units) |
| `json.parse("9007199254740992")` |  | Fails: `invalid-argument` — the JSON text has a number with no fraction that is not a whole number |
| `json.parse("1e400")` |  | Fails: `number-range` — the result of json.parse is out of range |
| `json.parse("[9007199254740993, x]")` |  | Fails: `invalid-argument` — the text is not valid JSON |
| `json.parse("[[[[1]]]]")` | `limits: depth = 3` | Fails: `depth-exceeded` |
